name: E-Bike Rebate
description: Up to $1,000 rebate for a new e-bike; must be enrolled in CARE or FERA; can combine with other e-bike rebates
fullDescription: WestLight Energy (formerly Peninsula Clean Energy) offers e-bike rebates to help income-qualified San Mateo County and Los Banos residents transition to clean transportation, reducing both costs and carbon emissions.
whatTheyOffer:
- Up to $1,000 (or the price of the e-bike, whichever is less) toward a new e-bike
- Available to CARE or FERA program participants
- Can combine with other e-bike rebates (apply the other rebate first)
- One rebate per address
- Free application help from Senior Coastsiders (650-726-9056) or El Concilio (650-703-3604)
howToGetIt:
1. Must be a WestLight Energy customer living in San Mateo County or Los Banos
2. CARE or FERA must already show on page 1 of your PG&E bill when you apply
3. The program is temporarily paused while it moves to a new system; fill out the interest form to be emailed when it relaunches
4. Once approved, buy your e-bike within 60 days
5. Have a government-issued photo ID (and proof of address if different)
keywords: e-bike, electric bicycle, rebate, WestLight Energy, Peninsula Clean Energy, PCE, San Mateo, Los Banos, CARE, FERA, clean transportation
